content: Governance/agent-docs surface (README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG, CODEOWNERS, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, RUNBOOK, docs/architecture.mmd, .claude/commands/{release,pr-reviews,issue-reviews,prioritize}) mirrors warren/seeds and the templates/l5-toolkit/docs templates. AGENTS.md must only name package.json scripts that actually exist (check:agents validator enforces this), so the check:* family was wired into package.json here even though the backing scripts/ ratchets land later in trellis-4ec4.

title: L5 quality toolkit port: co-located budgets, grandfathering, recursive test discovery
rationale: Ported templates/l5-toolkit/scripts (check-file-sizes/debt-markers/coverage, validate-agents-md, report-test-timing/quality-metrics + co-located *.test.ts + hooks/pre-commit) into scripts/. Key trellis adaptations: (1) budgets live CO-LOCATED in scripts/ (not a sibling budgets/), so each script's DEFAULT_*_PATH and report-quality-metrics resolve scripts/<name>.json; (2) debt tracker prefixes are trellis-/mx-/#NNN/URL; (3) budgets baselined to truth on disk per README §(b): file-size threshold=400 (ceil(343/50)*50+50), coverage floors functions=78/lines=74 (floor of observed 78.60/74.58 from bun text reporter), debt allowlist=[] (tree carries no untracked markers); (4) bunfig.toml DROPS [test] root='src' so bun's default recursive discovery runs both src/ and scripts/ tests (otherwise scripts/*.test.ts never run); (5) biome.json overrides grandfather the 3 complex toolkit scripts (check-debt-markers, check-file-sizes, validate-agents-md) with noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity:off, matching warren; (6) knip.json gets ignoreUnresolved:[bun-types] + ignoreDependencies:[js-yaml,@types/js-yaml,pino,zod] because those SPEC-declared deps aren't imported yet (commander is) — REMOVE from ignore as they get wired in; (7) check:agents passes --known-missing for forward-looking AGENTS.md refs (__golden__, targets.yaml, coverage/lcov.info, .github/workflows[/ci.yml]); (8) check:all order per trellis-4ec4: coverage→lint→typecheck→agents→size→debt→dups→deps. bun run check:all exits 0; each ratchet standalone exits 0; prepare installs core.hooksPath=scripts/hooks.

title: Stage-4 §6 contracts live in one src/contract/ module with a single SCHEMA_VERSION
rationale: SPEC §3.5 defines one schema version for the whole report/configuration contract family, so metric/finding/safeguard/coverage/report/config schemas landed together in src/contract/ rather than being scattered across not-yet-existing target-layout modules. zod v4 gotchas: .default({}) short-circuits without parsing — use .prefault({}) for deep nested defaults; strictObject rejection of unknown keys is the mechanism that keeps audit config hook-free and blocks scoring-weight overrides. Misleading-complete honesty is enforced as report-level superRefine invariants: completeness must equal the metric-state rollup and score.partial must equal (completeness === 'incomplete').

description: zod v4: z.record(z.enum(K), V) requires EVERY enum key present (exhaustive record); use z.partialRecord(z.enum(K), V) for optional per-key maps like observedCoverage.bySourceSet. Also .superRefine keeps .shape available on the refined schema.
resolution: Switched bySourceSet to z.partialRecord; tests green.

title: Provider contract state matrix
rationale: Contradictory provider statuses must be unrepresentable, so the five SPEC §16.2 states are cross-field rules on analysisResultSchema

content: Spawn-heavy CLI tests (src/cli/{pipe,report,audit,compare,exit-codes,fleet,main}.test.ts) carry an explicit 20000ms third-arg test timeout: each spawns bun 1-3 times and the 5s default is marginal under --coverage in slow containers. The gate is terminal, so flaky timeouts get fixed, not retried.

description: jscpd normalized clone GROUP members can violate the versioned clone-evidence contract on real code: the pinned tool reports multiline end columns approximately, so two records of one content-identical class can name the same location (path, start line/column, end line) with different end columns — equal under compareCloneLocations, distinct under step-13's compareMembersTotal. Step-13 already treats contract-equal PAIR members as degenerate; the group fold deduped only under the total order, so schema-validated reports rejected the evidence (found by dogfooding the step-15 provider-enabled audit over trellis itself).
resolution: Dedupe group members under the contract's order (compareCloneLocations) in src/providers/jscpd/evidence.ts groupEntry: members sorted by the total order keep the deterministic first (smallest end column); dropped spans keep line accounting and stay visible in raw facts. Regression test: src/providers/jscpd/normalize-order.test.ts.

title: Provider selection is a strict per-provider config block; one jscpd mode per request
rationale: The evidence-area schema allows exactly one entry per provider id and the per-mode normalized metrics share ids, so multiple modes of one provider can never fold into one honest entry — a different mode is a different analysis identity. The providers block (src/contract/config.ts) is a strictObject naming exactly the supported provider ids (unknown id = actionable schema error, operational exit 1) with per-provider request shapes: jscpd requires an explicit mode (exact|normalized|near, pinned thresholds not configurable), undelivered/gated providers take empty requests that resolve to located unsupported evidence with the capability table's recorded reason. Delivered providers (capabilities.ts status 'delivered', requestState absent) resolve per run; the default block selects nothing and stays byte-identical, no-write, offline.

title: Fleet provider scope is by construction; step 20 proves it, adds no orchestration logic
rationale: The fleet folds one isolated runWorkspaceAudit per target with the target's own config, so per-target provider selection, staged views (fresh mkdtemp per analysis), scratch cleanup and evidence isolation already hold without any provider logic in src/fleet/. Step 20 (trellis-f3e5) therefore delivered proof, not orchestration: real-core fleet tests (src/fleet/providers.test.ts) plus SDK/CLI fleet parity tests (src/client/fleet-provider-parity.test.ts) reusing the step-19 case matrix (native-only, jscpd-complete, unavailable install, unsupported-deferred, required-evidence). The fleet stays sequential (bounded concurrency of one) — a fleet-level AbortSignal/scheduling surface is deliberately absent; per-target cancellation and cleanup ride the single-audit core lifecycle, and an audit-service signal option would belong to the audit seam, not the fleet line.

content: bun:test inline snapshots (src/**/__snapshots__/*.snap) regenerate via 'bun test <file> --update-snapshots' when output changes intentionally; __golden__/ fixtures still require a documented update gate.

ANALYZER_VERSION is aliased to package VERSION (src/contract/version.ts), so a release bump must update the two tests pinning it (scripts/smoke-package.test.ts, src/client/duplication-cutover.test.ts). Every release makes older saved baselines incomparable (compare fails closed on analyzer-version); state that in CHANGELOG. No git release tags exist: find the last release via git log --grep='^release' and package.json version history. Breaking removals go in MINOR pre-1.0.
